command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP1: write /etc/pam.d/base-password with pwquality"
cat > /etc/pam.d/base-password <<'EOF'
# basic PAM configuration for Alpine.
# Enforce password complexity: minimum length 12, at least 3 character classes.
password requisite pam_pwquality.so retry=3 minlen=12 minclass=3
password required pam_unix.so use_authtok nullok sha512 shadow

# desktop keyrings
-password optional pam_gnome_keyring.so use_authtok
-password optional pam_kwallet5.so
EOF
echo "STEP2: show result"
cat /etc/pam.d/base-password
echo "STEP3: create a test user"
adduser -D -s /bin/sh pwtestuser
echo "STEP4: attempt weak password (too short) - expect failure"
printf 'Short1!\nShort1!\n' | passwd pwtestuser && echo "UNEXPECTED_SUCCESS_SHORT" || echo "EXPECTED_REJECT_SHORT"
echo "STEP5: attempt weak password (12+ chars but only 2 classes: all lowercase) - expect failure"
printf 'onlylowercaseletters\nonlylowercaseletters\n' | passwd pwtestuser && echo "UNEXPECTED_SUCCESS_2CLASS" || echo "EXPECTED_REJECT_2CLASS"
echo "STEP6: attempt strong password (12+ chars, 3 classes: upper/lower/digit) - expect success"
printf 'Str0ngPassw0rd\nStr0ngPassw0rd\n' | passwd pwtestuser && echo "EXPECTED_SUCCESS_STRONG" || echo "UNEXPECTED_FAIL_STRONG"
echo "STEP7: verify shadow entry updated"
grep pwtestuser /etc/shadow
